name: Pillar
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
long_description: Pillar is designed to solve healthcare’s longitudinal engagement problem through a combination of our SOC 2-certified, HIPAA-compliant platform and health coach workforce. Our white-label infrastructure enables companies to guide patients from outreach and activation through to flexible microsites and automated digital pathways including content, services, vendors and forms. Together with our in-house network of 1,200+ health coaches, Pillar partners drive positive outcomes through scalable digital care programs focused on health education and care navigation to chronic condition management.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Jasmine is the Founder & Co-CEO of Pillar, a white-label care enablement platform for healthcare. Prior to Pillar, she established and led the Strategy team at Forge (NYSE:FRGE) scaling the company to become the leading global private securities marketplace.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Caroline is the Founder & Co-CEO of Pillar, a white-label care enablement platform for healthcare. Prior to Pillar, she operated as #2 at L. (YC S15), a consumer women’s health company acquired by Procter & Gamble in 2019.
